verdict.rationale: Okta's first-party docs describe event hooks as outbound HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify, sent when specified events occur in your org. That is a registrable outbound webhook a downstream system can consume, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is thin beyond that one concept description. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that user lifecycle and authentication event types are subscribable, detail on delivery and verification (retries, signing, latency), independent or hands-on corroboration.
